title: ALIGN_RIDGE payload
description: Align a ridge line (v0.2 C.7, D.3; v0.3 §6; spec §10.7). KEEP_RIDGE is not allowed here (v0.3 §6).

mode.description: Any other mode is INVALID_PAYLOAD / INVALID_MODE (v0.2 C.7).

targetLine.description: Required except for KEEP_PLANES; with KEEP_PLANES an arbitrary target is a domain refusal (GT-09), not a schema error.

$comment: `edgeId`, `mode`, `targetLine`, `hardConstraintIds` as in v0.2 D.3; [P] measurementIds; [A] targetLine optional for FIT_MEASUREMENTS.
